name: Domain Traversal
description: This module adds new menu items per domain to easily traverse between the domains.
project_description: Easy navigation between domains for logged-in users on a multi-domain (Domain module) site. It adds one admin menu item per active domain; clicking another domain's link redirects the current user to that domain and finalizes a login there via a short-lived HMAC secret, so the user arrives already logged in. Access is gated by the module's own 'traverse domains' / 'traverse all domains' permissions and, when the Domain Access submodule is present, by the user's assigned domains. Requires the Domain module.
